facts.fact: 章首：整夜奔逃只停下补她头部裂伤；日出后小树林歇息
facts.anchor: She and Lucas ran through the night, stopping only long enough to mend the gash on her head.

facts.fact: 悲忆 Tolan：家乡有爱人等他共建未来——如今没了
facts.anchor: He had a girl whom he loved waiting for him back home. A future to build with her. Now, he was gone.

facts.fact: Daegal 前一分钟带队下一刻被掀下马；她自责一点忙没帮上
facts.anchor: Strong and unbreakable, determined to keep them all safe. Leading them one moment, swiped off his horse the next.

facts.fact: 她自剖：Egeria 看错了——我不像母亲那样强大有天赋
facts.anchor: Egeria had it wrong. I may be Cecilia’s daughter, but I’m nothing like my mother.

facts.fact: Lucas 说"你是 Cecilia 之女"被她吼断——别把我塑造成英雄，她骗了我（两遍）
facts.anchor: “I’m not her!” Andra shouted through gritted teeth.

facts.fact: Lucas 重新定义：药水师/防御队员表亲/侄女/朋友/平庸元素使
facts.anchor: Daughter of Cecilia the Light Witch, yes, but also the tonic crafter of the Southern Woods.

facts.fact: Lucas："要'完整的你'去阻止 Vasara"，我每一步都在
facts.anchor: It’s you as a whole who is meant to stop Vasara. And you don’t have to do it alone.

facts.fact: 忆童年树屋：搭了一整周就为生日前夜睡进去；那是最后一次真正快乐
facts.anchor: We spent an entire week building that rickety treehouse, just so we could spend the night before my birthday in it.

facts.fact: 幸福盘点：认识幸福（Lucas/Fergal/Bernice/Lydia）但入骨的满足自母亲死夜起没有过
facts.anchor: I haven’t felt that since the night my mother died.

facts.fact: 骑马到东北海岸还要一周多；他也没去过只听父亲提过
facts.anchor: On horseback, it would be another week or so? Maybe more.

facts.fact: 血魔法鉴定：母亲研究出以施术者自己的血为燃料——"太惊人了"
facts.anchor: I think my mother figured out how to use the blood of the witch casting to fuel the spell. It’s… amazing, really.

facts.fact: Lucas 让步"We start small"；她坦白就算你反对也会做
facts.anchor: “Because I was going to do it even if you disagreed.”
